description: Global terrain: NOAA ETOPO 2022 surface elevation as Terrarium-encoded elevation tiles, land only.
licence: Public domain. NOAA: 'not subject to copyright protection in the United States', and waived worldwide under CC0 1.0. See provenance/terms/noaa-etopo-2022-metadata.md
citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74

encoding.heights: metres above mean sea level (ETOPO's EGM2008 geoid), rounded to whole metres. Not corrected to the WGS84 ellipsoid, so they sit on the globe relative to sea level (the difference is up to about 100 m, depending on place).
encoding.sea: Heights below 0 are set to 0, including land below sea level (e.g. the Dead Sea shore, Death Valley). Tiles with no height above 0 aren't written; tiles.json lists those that are.
encoding.resampling: Reprojected once to the zoom-8 Web Mercator grid ('average' where a grid cell is larger than a source cell, otherwise 'bilinear'), then 2 x 2 averages for each zoom out.

sources.dataset: ETOPO 2022 v1, 15 arc-second, surface elevation, GeoTIFF
sources.producer: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
